outlook.statement: The completion of this settlement is expected to further strengthen the Company's financial position, enhance stakeholder confidence, and provide a strong foundation for sustainable long-term growth.

This addition is expected to strengthen SMART's integrated logistics business, enhance operational efficiencies, and support future business growth by expanding its rail-linked cargo handling capabilities and revenue-generating potential.
In line with its strategic growth objectives, PVLPL entered the national super stockist model within pharmaceutical sector, aiming to have high growth and value addition in the health care industry.
Since April 2026, the company has expanded to Kerala, Haryana, Ahmedabad, and Punjab will elevate the footprint to eight (8) states.

India's logistics sector poised for sustained long-term growth supported by macroeconomic fundamentals, industrialisation, manufacturing expansion, rising consumption and infrastructure investments. Government initiatives (National Logistics Policy, PM Gati Shakti, Bharatmala, Sagarmala, Dedicated Freight Corridors, Multimodal Logistics Parks) expected to improve supply chain efficiency and create opportunities. Mining sector to remain key growth driver with focus on increasing domestic coal production. Company received Letter of Acceptance from South Eastern Coalfields Limited for Rs. 4,03,800 lakh (incl. GST) for Porda Chimtapani, Chhattisgarh project. CFS business to benefit from EXIM trade growth, containerisation and port infrastructure investments. Warehousing and integrated supply chain demand to remain robust driven by manufacturing, organised retail, e-commerce and 3PL. Pristine Group integration provides operational synergies, cross-selling and improved resource utilisation.

The Company remains focused on developing talent, strengthening diversity and inclusion, and fostering a high-performance culture aligned with its business objectives, growth aspirations and commitment to operational excellence.
